description: Language-neutral vectors of the CPU rule of remote-execution headroom: a machine whose one-minute load per core is at or above the ceiling refuses with `load` and reports no headroom; an unknown load never refuses; the coordinator (origin ending in `-server`) registers `reservedSlots` fewer slots than its concurrency, at least one; every other machine registers all.
